From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: RE: DPA and SOC2 evidence for upcoming contract

Jordan / Ben / Emma — I reviewed FinInsight's comments. Quick summary:

- Retention: their ask to limit backups to 30 days conflicts with our operational needs for 90-day cache/backups. We can offer a compromise: 60 days for backups with a documented retention flow and SLA.
- Subprocessors: they listed several items they want opt-in for. We disclose subprocessors in our security page and offer universe-level notification + a 30-day cure period before onboarding new subprocessors.
- Data export & deletion: their redline wants an immediate deletion SLA on request; we propose a 30-day deletion window for full data & 48 hours for account-level access revocation.

I attached our redline (RI_DPA_Redline_v1.docx) with markup and an exceptions list for exec review. If procurement needs an approval path, suggest: Legal -> CRO review -> Exec sign (1-2 business days).

We’ll also prepare a short evidence bundle for SOC2 (scope, auditor, control summary). Ben — can you confirm whether we can include a sanitized evidence pack and whether any items are Restricted (need an NDA)?

Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Security | Redwood Inference
(Attachment: RI_DPA_Redline_v1.docx - 18 KB)

Hi Marissa / Jordan — thanks for the quick turnaround. We attached a countertrack with inline notes (FININSIGHT_DPA_Countertrack_2027.pdf). Two clarifications:

- The retention compromise to 60 days is acceptable if you can confirm archival deletions are irreversible after the window. Please add a sentence to the DPA confirmation clause.
- On subprocessors, we need a commitment to notify us 30 days prior to engaging any subprocessors that will handle EU personal data. If a subprocessors list is published, a notification + 30-day right to object is fine.

We prefer DocuSign and will send the envelope; please confirm the signer for Redwood (title and name) and anyone who needs to be on the docusign audit trail (legal/custodial).

Thanks,
Procurement Team
FinInsight
(Attachment: FININSIGHT_DPA_Countertrack_20270406.pdf - 64 KB)
